entities.name: Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal

entities.summary: The Tibetan lama Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal's unification of Bhutan, his creation of the unique dual system (religious and secular leaders), the codification of Driglam Namzha (national etiquette), and the construction of magnificent dzong fortresses.
